_instructions: This file defines department-specific configurations for syncing Freshservice tickets to Jira.
Each department owns a set of Freshservice agents and routes tickets to a specific Jira project.
TO ADD A NEW DEPARTMENT:
1. Add a new department object to the 'departments' array below
2. Fill in all required fields (see schema below)
3. Configure assignment_map to route tickets by category/subcategory
4. Optionally configure status_sync_map for reverse (Jira → Freshservice) status updates
5. No code changes required - the framework is fully data-driven
DEPARTMENT SCHEMA:
dept_id (string, required): Unique identifier (e.g., 'wms', 'fpna', 'it')
name (string, required): Human-readable department name
agent_ids (array of integers, required): Freshservice agent IDs owned by this department
jira_project_key (string, required): Jira project key (e.g., 'FRE', 'FPA')
jira_issue_type_id (string, required): Jira issue type ID for created issues
jira_board_id (integer, required): Jira board ID for querying issues
jira_default_status (string, optional): Default status for newly created issues (default: 'Backlog')
enabled (boolean, optional): Whether this department is active (default: true)
sync_comments (boolean, optional): Enable comment sync (default: true)
sync_attachments (boolean, optional): Enable attachment sync (default: true)
ASSIGNMENT_MAP SCHEMA:
Maps Freshservice category/subcategory to Jira assignee (email or accountId)
Structure: { 'Category Name': { 'Subcategory Name': 'assignee@example.com', 'default': 'fallback@example.com' } }
Matching is case-insensitive
Use 'default' key for fallback within a category
STATUS_SYNC_MAP SCHEMA (optional):
Maps Jira status names to Freshservice status codes for reverse sync (Jira → Freshservice)
Structure: { 'Jira Status Name': 'Freshservice Status Code' }
Common Freshservice status codes: '2' = Open, '3' = Pending, '4' = Resolved, '5' = Closed
Leave empty {} if you don't want Jira status changes to update Freshservice
NOTES:
- Agent IDs cannot be duplicated across departments
- Subcategories are automatically converted to Jira labels (e.g., 'Dashboard Not Refreshing' → 'dashboard-not-refreshing')
- Status sync is idempotent and tracks last synced status to avoid loops
